paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.61 as of the date November 13, 2026, with a change of 26.7 percent compared to the prior close. The price has decreased by 17.41 percent over a window of 23 sessions. There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours.
